description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and "Eval PPL." for four different model configurations. The x-axis represents the "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" on a reversed linear scale, ranging from 100 down to 25, with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis represents "Eval PPL." on a linear scale, with visible tick marks ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 at intervals of 0.5, accompanied by horizontal dashed gridlines. A dashed brown line with no markers, corresponding to a redacted legend entry, remains constant at a y-value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis range. The solid grey line with square markers, labeled "Only MoHD FFN," begins at an x-value of 100 with a y-value of approximately 11.4, decreases slightly to roughly 11.3 at an x-value of 50, and then increases to end at approximately 11.8 at an x-value of 25. The solid dark blue line with circle markers, labeled "Only MoHD ATTN," starts at an x-value of 100 with a y-value of approximately 11.4, increases to roughly 11.6 at an x-value of 75, continues to rise to about 12.25 at an x-value of 50, and reaches a peak of approximately 14.3 at an x-value of 25. Finally, the solid light blue line with 'x' markers, labeled "MoHD ATTN + MLP," begins at an x-value of 100 with a y-value of approximately 11.4, rises to about 11.5 at an x-value of 75, increases to roughly 12.05 at an x-value of 50, and ends at approximately 13.2 at an x-value of 25.
